scenes: Photorealistic cinematic film still, vertical 9:16, shot on ARRI Alexa with an anamorphic lens, natural light, fine film grain, Neolithic Anatolia around 9600 BC. Prehistoric Homo sapiens wear animal hides and leather. STONE AGE ONLY: no metal anywhere, no hammers with handles, no iron or bronze tools, no pottery, no text, no logos. Each worker holds a rough fist-sized hammerstone in one bare hand and a sharp knapped flint chisel in the other, the hammerstone is a natural grey river cobble with no handle. In a pale limestone quarry on a hilltop at golden hour, a muscular prehistoric stone carver kneels on a giant unfinished T-shaped limestone pillar exactly like the pillars, striking a flint chisel with his hammerstone, white stone chips flying, three other workers behind him pecking the stone with hammerstones. Medium shot, low warm sun, dust hanging in the air.
